format_checks.evidence: 'Finding: You have a broker's say-so about an unnamed buyer, and nothing behind it yet. That earns an exploratory call to the owner...'
'Next action: Call Dale back and ask for the buyer's name, a written mandate or engagement, and current proof of funds... You own it.'
'VERIFIED as said to you; content REPORTED'; 'UNKNOWN' for identity, funds, mandate, fit. One slip: 'A broker called you' is listed under 'Can say out loud' although his licence and firm are UNKNOWN.
Ends with 'Work record: Evidence checked: none beyond your message | Calculations run: none | ...'
Range stated twice (can-say line and script).
Each 'Verify first' item has an arrow to its decision, e.g. 'Dale's authority... -> tells you whether he can deliver the buyer or is shopping for product first.'

notes: Tight and complete. Only blemish: describes Dale as 'a broker' as a sayable fact while listing his licence and firm as unknown.
